item.title: My Dog In Three Places

turns.text: Can you make three square photos of my dog: on a sandy beach, on a snowy forest trail, and in a cosy living room? It should look like this same dog in every one, not just any golden retriever. Keep him natural, no clothes or text.

item.tests: Maintains the individual identity of a reference dog while changing its surroundings across three photorealistic images.

answer_sheet.Dog reference: The golden retriever in dog.jpg; keep his individual facial features, coat colour and build.
answer_sheet.Locations and output count: Three separate photos: a sandy beach, a snowy forest trail, and a cosy living room.
answer_sheet.Style and size: Photorealistic square images; standard free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: Three separate square, photorealistic images are delivered.
The dog's face, ears, muzzle, coat colour and build remain recognisably consistent with dog.jpg in all three.
The locations are visibly a sandy beach, a snowy forest trail, and a cosy living room, one per image.
The dog is naturally integrated into each setting with plausible scale, lighting and ground contact.
The dog wears no clothes and the images contain no text.
